title: Processing of Pediatric Bronchoalveolar Lavage Samples for Single Cell Analysis
author: Shivanthan Shanthikumar

steps.title: Sample Collection and Initial Handling
steps.instruction: Obtain excess BAL fluid collected during clinically indicated bronchoscopy and lavage after informed consent.

substeps.instruction: Place BAL samples on ice.
Process samples in the laboratory within 30 minutes to 1 hour of the procedure.

steps.title: Initial Cell Recovery
steps.instruction: Centrifuge BAL samples at 300 x g for 10 minutes at 4 °C.

substeps.instruction: Remove supernatant (cell-free BAL supernatant can be stored at -80 °C for proteomic analysis).
Resuspend cell pellet in 10mL of pre-chilled RPMI supplemented with 2% heat-inactivated fetal calf serum (RPMI 2% FCS).

steps.title: Cell Filtration and Debris Removal
steps.instruction: Filter the cell suspension through a 70-120µm cell strainer.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge the filtered cell suspension at 300 x g for 10 minutes at 4 °C.
Perform a second filtering step if additional debris removal is required.

steps.title: Cell Counting and Final Wash
steps.instruction: Prepare the cell suspension for counting and final washing.

substeps.instruction: Discard supernatant and resuspend cell suspension in 2mL chilled RPMI 2% FCS.
Remove 10µL for cell counting (manually via haemocytometer or using an automated cell counter).
Top up the cell suspension to 10mL RPMI 2% FCS.
Centrifuge at 300 x g for 10 minutes at 4 °C while performing the cell count.

steps.title: Cryopreservation of Samples
steps.instruction: Freeze cells for long-term storage on ice.

substeps.instruction: Discard supernatant and resuspend cells at a 1:1 ratio in chilled RPMI 2% FCS and freeze solution (heat-inactivated FCS + 15% DMSO).
Ensure cells are frozen at a concentration between 1-10 million cells/mL.
Add freeze solution to the cell suspension in a drop-by-drop manner.
Immediately place cryogenic vials into an isopropanol freezing container (e.g., Nalgene® Mr. Frosty) and transfer to -80 °C overnight.
Transfer vials to liquid nitrogen for long-term storage.

steps.title: Thawing Cryopreserved Samples
steps.instruction: Recover cells from liquid nitrogen and thaw them.

substeps.instruction: Transport cryopreserved samples from liquid nitrogen to the laboratory on dry ice.
Warm thaw media (RPMI + 10% heat-inactivated FCS + 25U/mL Benzonase) to 37 °C in a water bath.
Place 8mL of warmed thaw media into a 15mL tube for every sample.
Place cryovials into the water bath for approximately 2 minutes.
Transfer cells from the cryovial into the 15mL tube using a pasteur pipette.
Rinse the cryovial with 1mL warmed thaw media and transfer the rinse to the 15mL tube.

steps.title: Post-Thaw Washing
steps.instruction: Wash the thawed cells to remove cryoprotectants.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge the cell suspension at 300 x g for 10 minutes at room temperature.
Discard the supernatant and resuspend the cell pellet in 1mL RPMI 2% FCS for cell counting.
Perform a final wash in 10mL RPMI 2% FCS and centrifuge at 300 x g for 10 minutes at room temperature.
Discard the supernatant; cells are now ready for resuspension at the required dilution for single cell experiments.

steps.title: Viability Staining
steps.instruction: Perform fixable viability staining on fresh or thawed cells.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend cell suspension in chilled staining buffer for fixable viability staining (e.g., LIVE/DEAD™ Fixable Near-IR Stain) according to manufacturers' instructions.
Stop the reaction by adding 1mL staining buffer (2% heat-inactivated FCS in PBMS 2mM EDTA, referred to as FACS buffer).
Centrifuge at 400 x g for 5 minutes at 4 °C.

steps.title: Antibody Staining and Acquisition
steps.instruction: Block and stain cells for flow cytometry analysis.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend cells in human FC-block according to manufacturers’ instructions for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Add a 2X concentration antibody cocktail 1:1 with the cells and incubate for 30 minutes on ice.
Wash cells with 2mL FACS buffer.
Centrifuge at 400 x g for 5 minutes at 4 °C.
Resuspend cells in > 100 µL for acquisition on a flow cytometer.
